behavior.export: NDJSON workspace export covers all tenant-owned data models: workspace, brand/versions, safe member profiles, campaigns, content, versions, comments, assets, render jobs, media generation, AI jobs/runs/steps/usage, credit accounts/entries/reservations, audit activity, invitations (tokenHash stripped), socialConnection (ciphertexts stripped), contentClaimReview, publicationIntent (requestKey/requestHash stripped), publicationSchedule (requestKey stripped), publicationAttempt (uploadSessionCiphertext, requestKey, requestHash stripped), publicationPolicyReview, billingSubscription, billingEvent, and billingInvoice. Export is sha256-verified and rate-limited to 1 request/min per user/workspace.
behavior.memberRevocation: DELETE /api/workspaces/:organizationId/operations/members/:targetUserId: restricted to OWNER/ADMIN; prohibits self-revocation (403); deletes membership and invalidates active user sessions; preserves immutable financial records (CreditEntry, CreditReservation) and workspace audit logs; appends member.revoked audit event.
behavior.tests: 9 unit tests in tests/data-governance.test.ts + 10 integration scenarios in tests/integration/data-export.test.ts covering NDJSON checksum integrity, credential stripping, invitation hash stripping, render token stripping, credit key stripping, publication intent/attempt/schedule request key and hash redaction with populated fixtures, self-revocation guard, role boundaries, tenant isolation, rate limiting, and session invalidation.

limits: Workspace record export in NDJSON format only; does not embed raw binary media objects or scene cache bytes
Safe member-data revocation only; full legal erasure / organization deletion with financial foreign-key reconciliation remains separate
Windows environment limits: broad font/librsvg rendering unit suite runs on Linux CI
